title: Lost under Section 34: can you file a writ?

scenes.dialogue: Advocates, you lost your Section Thirty Four challenge to an M S M E Council's award. Can you now skip the appeal and file a writ petition instead?
scenes.shown: Advocates, you lost your Section 34 challenge to an MSME Council's award. Can you now skip the appeal and file a writ petition instead?

scenes.dialogue: Here, a State corporation held back over nineteen lakh rupees from a supplier. It lost before the Council, lost at Kanpur, then filed a writ in Madras. Will that work?
scenes.shown: Here, a State corporation held back over ₹19 lakh from a supplier. It lost before the Council, lost at Kanpur, then filed a writ in Madras. Will that work?

scenes.dialogue: Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. In Madras, Honourable Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Honourable Justice G Arul Murugan ruled.
In two thousand nine, the Tamil Nadu Medical Services Corporation ordered one hundred and thirty diesel generator sets for primary health centres.
scenes.shown: In 2009, the Tamil Nadu Medical Services Corporation ordered 130 diesel generator sets for primary health centres.

scenes.dialogue: Citing delay, it deducted liquidated damages. The supplier went to the U P M S M E Council. Its award ordered a refund with interest.
scenes.shown: Citing delay, it deducted liquidated damages. The supplier went to the UP MSME Council. Its award ordered a refund with interest.

scenes.dialogue: The Corporation's Section Thirty Four challenge at Kanpur was dismissed. It then filed a writ in the Madras High Court, and a Single Judge dismissed that too.
scenes.shown: The Corporation's Section 34 challenge at Kanpur was dismissed. It then filed a writ in the Madras High Court, and a Single Judge dismissed that too.

scenes.dialogue: On appeal, the Corporation said a writ lies for jurisdictional flaws. The supplier said: having lost under Section Thirty Four, it cannot now disown the award.
scenes.shown: On appeal, the Corporation said a writ lies for jurisdictional flaws. The supplier said: having lost under Section 34, it cannot now disown the award.

scenes.dialogue: Before I tell you what the High Court decided, a quick request: follow LawWorld, and try India's all in one A I platform for advocates at lawworld dot A I.
scenes.shown: Before I tell you what the High Court decided, a quick request: follow LawWorld, and try India's all-in-one AI platform for advocates at lawworld.ai.

scenes.dialogue: Finally, what did the High Court decide? A Council award has the same force as any arbitral award. A writ cannot replace a Section Thirty Seven appeal.
scenes.shown: Finally, what did the High Court decide? A Council award has the same force as any arbitral award. A writ cannot replace a Section 37 appeal.

scenes.dialogue: A party cannot call the order an award for one purpose and a nullity for another. The writ appeal was dismissed, and the interim stay was vacated.
